race.description: East Gippsland Communites Day - Packages On Sale 01/11 Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: ASMITA (11) is a consistent mare who has found it hard to win another race. She finished on strongly after finding trouble in the running as the favourite last time out at Tatura, and should stay out of any tight racing from a wide gate in this. With some better luck, she can make amends, so follow your money. PULL MY FINGER (7) switched back to the turf here just over 3 weeks ago, and drove late to finish runner-up by a head as the favourite after missing the kick. With an even beginning this time, he can go one better. LUMINARY MISS (6) made up for an unlucky run at her penultimate start by scoring by a short-head here just over 3 weeks ago. She maps to receive another cosy run just off the pace, and there is no reason why, she can't repeat. I AM ALGADON (10) had plenty of jump-out experience before making a winning debut at Tatura, scoring by over a length. This is not much harder, so stick with her. SUB GAUGE (1) has been plain since winning here in July. One more chance.
